blocks.text: Part of our award-winning PSW Pot Collection, the Simplicity Window Box from Arcadia Garden Products is made from a mix of recycled plastic, stone powder, and wood dust. With the substantial look of cement, this durable but lightweight planter is low and wide. Its window box shape is popular for planting and displaying in outdoor gardens, on patios and porches and inside the home. Planted with flowers and foliage this indoor/outdoor container is sure to capture attention. Slight variations in the appearance of each planter give the finish nearly a hand-crafted look. Grand enough to be positioned in a commercial setting such as a restaurant or office lobby, this sturdy planter is available in two colors and two sizes. Planted or plain, the handsome container also makes a thoughtful gift for gardeners and those who delight in home decorating. The winning combination of recycled ingredients in the PSW line makes this an attractive, eco-friendly product, which is also weather resistant and easy to clean. If used outdoors, the bottom of the planter indicates the ideal area for easy drilling. Coordinate the Simplicity Window Box with other PSW containers and count on enjoying long-lasting products in your home, garden, patio or porch.

items.label: LIGHTWEIGHT & DURABLE
items.value: When the look and durability of a concrete planter is wanted without the unyielding weight and breakability factor, this PSW window box-shaped planter fits the quest. It’s well-crafted while notably lightweight.

items.label: RECYCLED MATERIALS
items.value: A blend of recycled plastic, stone powder and wood dust is used to create this concrete-looking planter. PSW products are both attractive and eco-friendly, making them popular with environmental-minded gardeners.

items.label: ORIGINAL
items.value: The unique appearance of each PSW product is one-of-a-kind due to the blending of recycled materials. The slight variations in the finish infer an artisan’s touch, making these planters appealing and functional.

items.label: PROTECTIVE
items.value: Water spills from over-doused houseplants can ruin surfaces. This planter does not leak and safely contains moisture for potted ferns, foliage, and flowers. For outdoor use, this container can easily be drilled to allow for drainage.

items.label: VARIETY
items.value: Having choices makes a difference when creating a certain look in your garden or indoor plants area. PSW products are available in a variety of sizes and colors to complement your existing gardenscape or to create a new garden or patio look.
